parameters: S-Stop!!\! How did you get here?!\! This is highly forbidden!!
Is that so?\! I must have gotten lost.\! What's a girl to do...
Your father will hear of this!\! Y-you cannot be in here!!
Shut your mouth and do what you're told.
W...what?\! I don't have to listen to you!!
Hahahaha...\| look at you now.\! You human males are all alike.\! With little effort, you're putty in my hands.\! ...Aren't you, my little minion?
What are you doing here, Beatrix?\! I wish you would leave...
Oh, you love this, almost as much as I do.\! I'm just indulging my curiosity. Here you are, all cooped up, studying all this prophecy nonsense.\! I'd very much like to see your work!
....\| N-no, I...\| no one can see this!\! You won't even understand it! You'll ruin everything with your clumsy recklessness!
Wait just a minute...\| you're trying to provoke me now.\! Well, if it's gonna be that way, I'm leaving right now if you don't show me everything. Hmph!
No! Wait!\! Please, have a look around...
There you go!\! What are those scrolls there, hmm?
This is my transcription of the Historium Magnus...\! But it is a very delicate project, please, I beg you, do not interrupt it, or the translation will be ruined...
By Donar, you're doing this from memory? Always the consummate bookworm!\! Hmm, what's this map all about?
That transcription is complete...\| it is the locations of all five of the Nephilim shrines.\! If I were to retrieve the Historium Magnus again, the secrets within would...
...No kidding?\! Well, well... very good work here, Jebby.\! Good boys get rewarded, you know.
Mmhmm, that's right.\! Why don't you just look the other way while I study this map for myself.\! You wouldn't want to disappoint Beatrix would you?
You behave yourself while I'm away, my little Jeb.\! Farewell, until we meet again!
